preconditions.description: The number of cities in Tree Island is between 5 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= ai, bi <= n and ai != bi
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities.
The number of test cases is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= uj, vj, xj, yj <= n and uj != vj and xj != yj
preconditions.description: Each test case specifies two distinct cities for JH and JY to start running.

postconditions.description: The output for each test case is an integer representing the time they should run in minutes.

postconditions.expression: output is -1 if they never meet
postconditions.description: If JH and JY never meet at the same city, the output is -1.

postconditions.expression: output is 0 if they meet at the beginning
postconditions.description: If JH and JY meet at the same city at the start, the output is 0.

invariants.expression: The input represents a tree graph
invariants.description: The input describes a tree structure with n cities and n-1 roads.
The result for each test case does not affect the results of other test cases.
